people.name: Tekoa
people.line: Town in Judah, home of the prophet Amos

translations.web: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”
translations.bsb: When the woman from Tekoa went to the king, she fell facedown in homage and said, “Help me, O king!”
translations.kjv: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.
translations.asv: And when the woman of Tekoa spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.
